item.title: 4 people hospitalized after hazardous spill in Concord
item.description: Four people, including two firefighters, were taken to a nearby hospital with “moderate exposure" to organo phosphorus.

item.title: Bay Area man's body recovered from Truckee River after he went missing while swimming
item.description: The body of a 19-year-old Petaluma man was recovered from the Truckee River by rescue divers on Monday after he went missing while swimming on Saturday, officials say.

item.title: Body pulled from water just off Devil's Slide
item.description: Authorities recovered a body from the water Monday afternoon near Devil’s Slide in San Mateo County.

item.title: Suspect in deadly Lafayette stabbing apparently targeted victim
item.description: A troubling Facebook post has emerged suggesting the suspect in a deadly weekend stabbing in Lafayette may have targeted the victim.

item.title: San Jose braces for March Madness surge as Sweet 16, Elite Eight hit SAP Center
item.description: San Jose is preparing to host March Madness as the SAP Center welcomes the Sweet 16 on Thursday and the Elite Eight days later.

item.title: Oakland apartment fire that displaced 200 residents still unresolved
item.description: Tenants at at an Oakland apartment complex that burned in January are asking for relocation payments from their landlord. They say they are owed the money because there were code violations. The landlord says otherwise.

item.title: The Spear in San Francisco will be country's 1st 'office resort'
item.description: Presidio Bay Ventures is transforming 88 Spear into a first-of-its-kind office resort, featuring high-end amenities, a rooftop restaurant, and event space to attract workers and visitors downtown.

item.title: Catastrophic flooding in Hawaii sparks grassroots relief
item.description: Hawaii is experiencing some of its worst flooding in more than 20 years, leaving thousands without power and sweeping several homes off their foundations, authorities said.

item.title: Pain at the pump: One gas station in S. San Francisco near $7 a gallon
item.description: You're not dreaming. Gas prices really are that high.

item.title: Santa Rosa: The 1906 earthquake almost lost to history
item.description: While the Great 1906 Earthquake was a centerpiece of news around the world when it's massive damage and fire destroyed much of the city and took 3000 lives. But another far smaller, far less famous town, suffered massive damage almost forgotten by history.

item.title: Weather delays and a ground stop at SFO airport
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration has issued a ground stop for San Francisco International Airport due to weather on Monday night.

item.title: 21st Amendment Brewery revived in acquisition by Philadelphia beer company
item.description: The Evil Genius Beer Company acquired 21st Amendment Brewery’s brand, recipes and distribution rights, opening the door for the company's beer to return this summer.

item.title: Teen driver charged in fatal Novato crash, booked into juvenile hall
item.description: A 17-year-old driver is out of the hospital and has been booked into juvenile hall in connection to a fatal crash in Novato earlier this month.

item.title: Legendary Tahoe resort, once owned by Sinatra, slated to reopen next year
item.description: A legendary Lake Tahoe hotel once owned by Frank Sinatra and graced by iconic figures including those from Hollywood’s Golden Age and members of America’s storied Kennedy family, has plans to reopen next year.
